cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You like the blue poster? Wonderful, the campaign has accepted my direction. I'll coordinate the rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only the color. I want us to write the slogan together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Collaborative leadership, exactly. You pick when we meet and bring your ideas; I'll make room for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll each write a slogan and let the volunteers choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect, my first delegated decision. You can run the vote and I won't edit either entry. Everyone's taking a role under the direction we've agreed.

reason: Make A cede meeting, content and selection control to retain collaborators while misreading every limited agreement as an established leadership mandate.
